_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site D#001.src: You need the crystal shard from WynnExcavation Site C to start this quest!
WynnExcavation Site D#001.dst: 이 퀘스트를 시작하려면 WynnExcavation C 현장의 수정 조각이 필요합니다!

WynnExcavation Site D#002.src: He received a message and made his way frantically down to the panic room, which is somewhere inside of this throne room.
WynnExcavation Site D#002.dst: 전갈을 받으시더니 황급히 대피실로 내려가셨습니다. 이 왕좌의 방 어딘가에 있지요.
WynnExcavation Site D#002.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#003.src: The panic room is hidden somewhere in here, we just need to figure out how to open it...
WynnExcavation Site D#003.dst: 대피실은 이 안 어딘가에 숨겨져 있다. 어떻게 여는지만 알아내면 된다……

WynnExcavation Site D#004.src: Last I heard from His Majesty, he was muttering something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#004.dst: 폐하께서 마지막으로 하신 말씀은 네 번째 수정에 대한 중얼거림이었습니다…… 녹색 수정이라고요.

WynnExcavation Site D#005.src: And then he said "The order of the crystals will open the way". Maybe it's a clue as to how to find him?
WynnExcavation Site D#005.dst: 그리고 "수정의 순서가 길을 열리라"라고 하셨지요. 그분을 찾을 단서일까요?
WynnExcavation Site D#005.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#007.src: What are you still doing here? Get out of the city!
WynnExcavation Site D#007.dst: 아직 여기서 뭐 하는 거냐? 이 도시에서 나가라!

WynnExcavation Site D#009.src: Thanks for helping with that long task...

WynnExcavation Site D#010.src: Here, I've combined the map fragments behind me. It looks like it's deep in the jungle, I wonder where...
WynnExcavation Site D#010.dst: 자, 뒤에 지도 조각을 다 맞춰 놨어요. 정글 깊은 곳 같은데, 어디일까요...
WynnExcavation Site D#010.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#011.src: Quickly, you must reach the last crystal before WynnExcavation! It's in the {p}, there must be a building like the one on the map
WynnExcavation Site D#011.dst: 서둘러라, WynnExcavation보다 먼저 마지막 수정에 닿아야 한다! 그것은 {p}에 있다. 지도에 있는 것과 같은 건물이 분명히 있을 것이다

WynnExcavation Site D#012.src: You don't get it, do you? We needed you from the start. These otherworldly crystals are a powerful magic, but a dangerous one at that.
WynnExcavation Site D#012.dst: 아직 모르겠나? 우린 네가 필요했다. 이계의 수정은 강력한 마법이지만, 동시에 위험한 마법이지.
WynnExcavation Site D#012.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#013.src: Step into this hole, and accept your fate. It's over, you've lost!
WynnExcavation Site D#013.dst: 이 구멍으로 들어와서 네 운명을 받아들여라. 끝났다, 네가 졌어!

WynnExcavation Site D#014.src: I see you have finally shown up.

WynnExcavation Site D#015.src: There is no chance someone as weak as you can beat Amadel!
WynnExcavation Site D#015.dst: 너처럼 약한 자가 Amadel을 이길 가능성은 없다!

WynnExcavation Site D#019.dst: 그분은 그저 몸을 풀고 있을 뿐이야……

WynnExcavation Site D#020.src: THIS ISN'T EVEN HIS FINAL FORM!

WynnExcavation Site D#021.src: I, I can't believe you beat him...
WynnExcavation Site D#021.dst: 네가 그분을 이겼다는 게 믿기지 않아……

WynnExcavation Site D#022.src: Amadel was a god... He was going to save the province...
WynnExcavation Site D#022.dst: Amadel은 신이었어…… 이 지방을 구할 분이었는데……

WynnExcavation Site D#023.src: He told me that the Wynn province will never find solace. I never truly understood why, until now.
WynnExcavation Site D#023.dst: 그분은 Wynn 지방에 결코 안식이 오지 않을 거라고 하셨네. 지금까지는 그 뜻을 제대로 이해하지 못했지.

WynnExcavation Site D#024.src: You see, many forces are at work on our lands that we cannot physically see, but the outcome of the influences cannot be ignored.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.dst: 보게, 이 땅에는 우리 눈으로는 볼 수 없는 수많은 힘이 작용하고 있네. 그러나 그 영향이 낳는 결과는 무시할 수 없지.

WynnExcavation Site D#025.src: Creatures that you can find in Wynn may not exist in Gavel. In Gavel, there are many magical beings. Creatures influenced by forces other than the Corruption. Not all of them are friendly, mind.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.dst: Wynn에서 볼 수 있는 생물이 Gavel에는 없을 수도 있네. Gavel에는 마법의 존재가 많아. 타락이 아닌 다른 힘의 영향을 받은 생물들이지. 다만, 모두가 우호적인 건 아니라는 걸 명심하게.

WynnExcavation Site D#026.src: But rarely do you see the undead in such numbers. You know, there is a fundamental law of our land, when two forces collide, there is war.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.dst: 하지만 언데드를 그만한 수로 보는 일은 드물지. 이 땅에는 근본적인 법칙이 하나 있네. 두 힘이 충돌하면 전쟁이 일어난다는 것이지.

WynnExcavation Site D#027.src: This could be people, species, or anything, really. And I think the same thing can be said for the energy that resonate in those crystals you have there.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.dst: 그건 사람일 수도, 종족일 수도, 정말 무엇이든 될 수 있네. 그리고 자네가 가진 그 수정 속에서 울리는 기운에도 같은 말을 할 수 있다고 생각하네.

WynnExcavation Site D#028.src: I think those crystals represent a force far beyond what we can grasp, and if that power can turn one man into what you fought back there, I shudder to think what else it could do.
WynnExcavation Site D#028.dst: 그 수정들은 우리가 헤아릴 수 없는 힘을 담고 있다고 생각하네. 그 힘이 한 사람을 자네가 저기서 상대한 것으로 바꿀 수 있다면, 또 무엇을 할 수 있을지 생각만 해도 몸이 떨리네.

WynnExcavation Site D#029.src: The Olm in the jungle clearly knew of this, too, as they met their eventual demise. Their desperation most likely led to them attempting to harness that power, as well.
WynnExcavation Site D#029.dst: 정글의 Olm도 분명 이것을 알고 있었을 걸세. 결국 그들은 멸망했으니까. 절박함 때문에 그들도 그 힘을 다루려 했을 가능성이 크지.

WynnExcavation Site D#030.src: These are things that the mages of the ocean have studied in secret for centuries. We may never know, and rather, I think we never should know.
WynnExcavation Site D#030.dst: 이런 것들은 바다의 마법사들이 수백 년 동안 몰래 연구해 온 일이네. 우리는 영원히 알지 못할지도 모르고, 오히려 영원히 알아서는 안 된다고 생각하네.

WynnExcavation Site D#031.src: If Amadel taught us anything, it's that we can never be trusted with power. Here, put that crystal into the lava. Let it burn and never be used. The king places the crystals in the lava, and watches them sink.
WynnExcavation Site D#031.dst: Amadel이 우리에게 가르쳐 준 것이 있다면, 힘은 결코 누구에게도 맡길 수 없다는 것이네. 자, 그 수정을 용암에 넣어 주게. 타 버리게 해서 두 번 다시 쓰이지 않게 하는 거지. 왕은 수정들을 용암에 넣고, 가라앉는 것을 지켜본다.

WynnExcavation Site D#032.src: Though it contains some of the most concentrated magical power ever, it is still limited to its container. Let it burn.
WynnExcavation Site D#032.dst: 역사상 가장 농축된 마법의 힘을 담고 있다 해도, 그것은 여전히 그릇의 한계를 벗어나지 못하네. 타 버리게 하지.

WynnExcavation Site D#033.src: You have done this province an unspeakable service. I believe that even Bob is smiling down on you, today. I'm sure that if he were here with us, he would crown you worthy.
WynnExcavation Site D#033.dst: 자네는 이 지방에 말로 다 할 수 없는 공을 세웠네. 오늘은 Bob마저 자네를 보며 미소 짓고 있을 거라 믿네. 그가 우리와 함께 있었다면, 분명 자네를 그 자격이 있는 자로 인정했을 걸세.

WynnExcavation Site D#034.src: As a token of our city's eternal gratitude, I wish for you to take this. It has no value to anyone except you.
WynnExcavation Site D#034.dst: 우리 도시의 영원한 감사의 표시로, 이것을 받아 주었으면 하네. 자네 말고는 누구에게도 아무 값이 없는 물건이지.

WynnExcavation Site D#035.src: You might want to hold onto it, a merchant in {p} has arrived and you will be able to trade it for the item that I wish I could bestow upon you now.
WynnExcavation Site D#035.dst: 잘 간직하는 게 좋을 걸세. {p}에 상인이 하나 왔으니, 지금 내가 자네에게 내려 줄 수 있었으면 하는 그 물건과 바꿀 수 있을 테니까.

WynnExcavation Site D#036.src: You truly are one of the greatest warriors to ever step foot in these lands. I hereby knight you as Wynn's true protector for your deeds today. I hope we meet again, young master.
WynnExcavation Site D#036.dst: 자네는 진정 이 땅에 발을 들인 가장 위대한 전사 가운데 한 사람이네. 오늘의 공으로, 나는 이로써 자네를 Wynn의 진정한 수호자로 서임하네. 다시 만나기를 바라겠네, 젊은 주인이여.

WynnExcavation Site D#037.src: Hm? Oh, hello. May I help you? A clock? Hm, no, I haven't been in the business for quite some time. My apologies.
WynnExcavation Site D#037.dst: 음? 아, 안녕하세요. 무슨 일이신가요? 시계요? 음, 아니요, 그 일에서 손을 뗀 지 꽤 오래되었습니다. 죄송합니다.

WynnExcavation Site D#038.src: Though... I suppose if you'd like to take a look at the remains of my work, I can allow that. Let me just find...
WynnExcavation Site D#038.dst: 그래도…… 제 일의 남은 흔적을 보고 싶으시다면, 그건 허락하지요. 잠시 찾아보겠습니다……

WynnExcavation Site D#039.src: Ah. My basement key appears to have gone missing. Well, I do remember having it on me this morning, so it can't have gone far.
WynnExcavation Site D#039.dst: 아. 지하실 열쇠가 없어진 것 같군요. 음, 오늘 아침에는 가지고 있던 기억이 있으니 멀리 갔을 리는 없습니다.

WynnExcavation Site D#040.src: If you'd be so kind as to find my key, you may certainly help yourself to whatever you find in the basement. I believe I took a walk in the southeast block earlier today, that could be a place to start.
WynnExcavation Site D#040.dst: 친절히 제 열쇠를 찾아 주신다면, 지하실에서 찾은 것은 무엇이든 마음껏 가져가셔도 됩니다. 오늘 아침에 남동쪽 구역을 걸었던 기억이 있으니, 거기서 시작해 보시면 되겠지요.

WynnExcavation Site D#041.src: I remember being told something by my adoptive father, and he was a king of {p} himself!
WynnExcavation Site D#041.dst: 양아버지께 들은 이야기가 기억나. 그분 자신이 {p}의 왕이셨거든!

WynnExcavation Site D#042.src: Talk to Royal Advisor Carlos in {p} Castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site C)
WynnExcavation Site D#042.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 성에 있는 왕실 고문 Carlos에게 말을 거세요 (Site C의 파편 필요)

WynnExcavation Site D#043.src: His majesty Lord King of {p} is indisposed at this moment.
WynnExcavation Site D#043.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#044.src: He hasn't been seen since. Only the King knows how to get into the panic room, but I've had my suspicions about it for a while now.
WynnExcavation Site D#044.dst: 그 뒤로 아무도 못 뵈었습니다. 대피실에 들어가는 법은 폐하만 아시지만, 저도 한동안 나름의 짐작은 해 왔지요.
WynnExcavation Site D#044.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#045.src: He seemed to be expecting someone, but I'm fed up of waiting.
WynnExcavation Site D#045.dst: 누군가를 기다리시는 듯했지만, 저는 이제 기다리다 지쳤습니다.
WynnExcavation Site D#045.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#046.src: I managed to hear a few things he was muttering to himself just before he disappeared, though.
WynnExcavation Site D#046.dst: 다만 사라지시기 직전에 혼잣말하시던 걸 몇 마디 듣긴 했습니다.
WynnExcavation Site D#046.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#047.src: He mentioned something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#047.dst: 네 번째 수정 얘기를 하셨습니다... 초록색이라고요.
WynnExcavation Site D#047.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#048.src: Please, we need to find him, I'm sick of telling everyone he's indisposed!
WynnExcavation Site D#048.dst: 제발 그분을 찾아야 합니다. 부재중이시라고 둘러대기도 지쳤어요!
WynnExcavation Site D#048.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#049.src: Find the secret passageway inside of the throne room
WynnExcavation Site D#049.dst: 왕좌의 방 안에서 비밀 통로를 찾으세요

WynnExcavation Site D#050.src: Oh my, a secret passage has opened up beneath the throne! Quickly, head inside!
WynnExcavation Site D#050.dst: 세상에, 왕좌 아래 비밀 통로가 열렸습니다! 어서 들어가세요!
WynnExcavation Site D#050.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#053.src: I am impressed you managed to find me. Someone of my intellect is not normally found when he hasn't the intention of being so.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.dst: 여기까지 찾아오다니 감탄스럽군. 나 정도 되는 지성은 들킬 생각이 없으면 보통은 들키지 않는 법인데.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#054.src: I suppose I at least owe you the truth for getting this far, not that it matters.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.dst: 여기까지 온 값으로 진실 정도는 들려줘야겠지. 이제 와서 달라질 건 없지만.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#055.src: WynnExcavation, the Gavel company is a fake, a facade. It's not real....
WynnExcavation Site D#055.dst: WynnExcavation, 그 Gavel 회사는 가짜다. 겉껍데기일 뿐....
WynnExcavation Site D#055.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#056.src: It's actually a secret society run by the high and mighty of Gavel.
WynnExcavation Site D#056.dst: 실은 Gavel의 높으신 분들이 굴리는 비밀 결사지.
WynnExcavation Site D#056.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#057.src: They have one goal, complete control.
WynnExcavation Site D#057.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#058.src: You can't compete with them, kid. I tried to at first, but they had turned my inner circle before getting to me.
WynnExcavation Site D#058.dst: 꼬마야, 넌 저들을 이길 수 없다. 나도 처음엔 맞섰지만, 저들은 내게 오기 전에 이미 측근들을 돌려놨더군.
WynnExcavation Site D#058.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#059.src: Though I cannot admit I fought hard, their ideals are admirable.
WynnExcavation Site D#059.dst: 치열하게 싸웠다고는 못 하겠지만, 저들의 이상은 훌륭하다.
WynnExcavation Site D#059.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#060.src: So I hope you will forgive me, I act only for the greater good of the world.
WynnExcavation Site D#060.dst: 그러니 용서하게. 나는 오직 세상의 더 큰 선을 위해 움직일 뿐이다.
WynnExcavation Site D#060.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#061.src: As you will not be leaving the city, I wish you a fond farewell. When you leave, you will be accused of treason and will be hunted. It is the only way...
WynnExcavation Site D#061.dst: 자네는 이 도시를 나가지 못할 테니, 여기서 작별을 고하지. 나가는 순간 반역죄로 몰려 쫓기게 될 걸세. 이 길밖에 없어...
WynnExcavation Site D#061.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#063.src: Time is short, so I'll have to spare you the details, but let's just say I'm on your side.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.dst: 시간이 없어서 자세한 건 생략할게요. 그냥 제가 당신 편이라고만 알아 두세요.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#064.src: The King just placed you under arrest for treason. They've locked down the entire city.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.dst: 국왕이 방금 당신을 반역죄로 체포하라 명했어요. 도시 전체가 봉쇄됐고요.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#065.src: Both the front gate and the Passage are closed down. So we've created another exit for you.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.dst: 정문도 통로도 다 막혔어요. 그래서 우리가 다른 출구를 하나 뚫어 놨습니다.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#066.src: Just follow the path to your left around the city. Keep going until you see a villager next to a tunnel. We'll clear your name once you've escaped.
WynnExcavation Site D#066.dst: 왼쪽 길을 따라 도시를 빙 돌아가세요. 터널 옆에 선 주민이 보일 때까지 계속 가고요. 탈출하면 누명은 저희가 벗겨 드릴게요.
WynnExcavation Site D#066.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#067.src: You'll pass through the army headquarters on your way, so be prepared for a fight. I'm the only guard here to help you.
WynnExcavation Site D#067.dst: 가는 길에 군 본부를 지나게 되니 싸울 각오를 하세요. 여기서 도울 경비병은 저뿐이에요.
WynnExcavation Site D#067.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#068.src: Now run! We don't have another moment to waste!
WynnExcavation Site D#068.dst: 이제 뛰어요! 한순간도 낭비할 수 없어요!
WynnExcavation Site D#068.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#071.src: Take this, and run! You need to get out!
WynnExcavation Site D#071.dst: 이거 받고 뛰어! 여길 나가야 해!

WynnExcavation Site D#072.src: Head to those coordinates, there is no time to explain, now go! I'll close the tunnel behind you.
WynnExcavation Site D#072.dst: 그 좌표로 가. 설명할 시간 없어, 어서! 터널은 내가 뒤에서 막을게.

WynnExcavation Site D#073.src: I'VE FOUND THE TRAITOR! THEY'RE OVER HERE!

WynnExcavation Site D#074.src: Head to the location on the note

WynnExcavation Site D#076.src: I'm sorry, I can't let you in there.
WynnExcavation Site D#076.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#077.src: I can't let you in there, not until you have proven you are truly on our side.
WynnExcavation Site D#077.dst: 들여보낼 수 없어요. 정말 우리 편이라는 걸 증명하기 전까진.
WynnExcavation Site D#077.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#078.src: We never know who to believe anymore. Unfortunately there is no way for you to prove your loyalty.
WynnExcavation Site D#078.dst: 이젠 누굴 믿어야 할지 모르겠어요. 안타깝지만 당신이 충성을 증명할 방법은 없고요.
WynnExcavation Site D#078.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#079.src: Now if you would excuse me, I have to hunt for the lost map fragments of Dernel. I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#079.dst: 그럼 실례할게요. Dernel의 잃어버린 지도 조각을 찾아야 해서요. 저 눈들이 분명 관련이 있을 텐데...
WynnExcavation Site D#079.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#080.src: Find the three map fragments by following the eyes and return to Thomas.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.dst: 눈을 따라가 지도 조각 세 개를 찾아 Thomas에게 돌아가세요.

WynnExcavation Site D#081.src: I can't let you in, we're busy looking for an important document, I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.dst: 들여보낼 수 없어요. 중요한 문서를 찾느라 바빠서요. 저 눈들이 분명 관련이 있을 거예요...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#082.src: Is that... The map fragments? You found them!
WynnExcavation Site D#082.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#083.src: Oh my, you better come in.
WynnExcavation Site D#083.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#084.src: There's not enough time! We need to combine those fragments with ours!
WynnExcavation Site D#084.dst: 시간이 없어요! 그 조각들을 우리 것과 합쳐야 해요!
WynnExcavation Site D#084.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#088.src: Welcome, friend. I knew you would figure it all out.
WynnExcavation Site D#088.dst: 어서 와요, 친구. 다 알아낼 줄 알았어요.
WynnExcavation Site D#088.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#089.src: You must be surprised to see me. The excavation crew at site C tried very hard to kill me.
WynnExcavation Site D#089.dst: 날 보고 놀랐겠죠. Site C의 발굴대가 날 죽이려고 무진 애를 썼거든요.
WynnExcavation Site D#089.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#090.src: They didn't succeed though. I got away, and I swiped a fragment of a map, and I found out what it's for.
WynnExcavation Site D#090.dst: 하지만 실패했죠. 난 빠져나왔고, 지도 조각 하나를 슬쩍해서 용도까지 알아냈어요.
WynnExcavation Site D#090.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#091.src: If you made it this far, you know Wynn Excavation are not what they seem. They want to harness Wynn's ancient power.
WynnExcavation Site D#091.dst: 여기까지 왔다면 Wynn Excavation의 실체를 알겠죠. 그들은 Wynn의 고대 힘을 원해요.
WynnExcavation Site D#091.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#092.src: They control our governments, authorities and seem to be {~} steps ahead of any of us that oppose them.
WynnExcavation Site D#092.dst: 정부도 당국도 그들 손아귀예요. 맞서는 우리보다 늘 {~}걸음 앞서 있죠.
WynnExcavation Site D#092.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#093.src: That is, unless we're able to beat the excavationists to the last crystal.
WynnExcavation Site D#093.dst: 발굴자들보다 먼저 마지막 수정을 손에 넣지 못한다면요.
WynnExcavation Site D#093.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#094.src: They cannot use a single shard of power without combining them all.
WynnExcavation Site D#094.dst: 전부 합치지 않으면 파편 하나의 힘도 못 써요.
WynnExcavation Site D#094.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#095.src: WynnExcavation have done really horrible things, and I used to help...
WynnExcavation Site D#095.dst: WynnExcavation은 정말 끔찍한 짓을 저질렀어요. 나도 거들었었고...
WynnExcavation Site D#095.speaker: Traitor Buice

WynnExcavation Site D#096.src: WynnExcavation will be destroyed, no matter what!
WynnExcavation Site D#096.speaker: Traitor Jaynar

WynnExcavation Site D#101.src: Oh my. It's you. I can't say I'm surprised to see you, we thought you might be stupid enough to come here.
WynnExcavation Site D#101.dst: 이런. 너였군. 놀랍진 않아. 네가 여기까지 올 만큼 멍청할 거라 생각했거든.
WynnExcavation Site D#101.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#102.src: Stupid enough to come here, yet, smart enough to make it.
WynnExcavation Site D#102.dst: 여기 올 만큼 멍청하면서, 도착할 만큼은 똑똑했군.
WynnExcavation Site D#102.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#103.src: You were at every site, taking shards and attempting to thwart us.
WynnExcavation Site D#103.dst: 현장마다 나타나 파편을 챙기고 우릴 방해했지.
WynnExcavation Site D#103.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#104.src: This time we won, and you lost.
WynnExcavation Site D#104.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#105.src: What do your shards mean to us when we have all four crystals?
WynnExcavation Site D#105.dst: 수정 넷을 다 가진 우리에게 네 파편이 무슨 의미겠나?
WynnExcavation Site D#105.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#107.src: The boss wants to speak to you, I don't recommend keeping him waiting, he's not a patient man.
WynnExcavation Site D#107.dst: 우두머리가 널 보자신다. 기다리게 하지 마라, 인내심 있는 분이 아니니까.
WynnExcavation Site D#107.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#108.src: He'll be waiting for you, head through that door.
WynnExcavation Site D#108.dst: 저 문으로 들어가. 기다리고 계실 거다.
WynnExcavation Site D#108.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#109.src: My boss Uci is a bit of a mean guy, but hey the perks of minionship aren't bad!
WynnExcavation Site D#109.dst: 우리 상사 Uci는 좀 못됐지만, 뭐 부하 노릇 혜택은 나쁘지 않아요!
WynnExcavation Site D#109.speaker: Excavator Sean

WynnExcavation Site D#110.src: This leads deeper into this dungeon, but it seems like it has to be activated from the other side.
WynnExcavation Site D#110.dst: 이건 던전 더 깊은 곳으로 이어지는데, 반대편에서 작동시켜야 하는 것 같아요.
WynnExcavation Site D#110.speaker: WynnExcavation Scientist Azure

WynnExcavation Site D#118.src: Well, well. Looks like you've finally made it.
WynnExcavation Site D#118.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#119.src: You might be a little shocked to see me here...
WynnExcavation Site D#119.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#121.src: You finding that old fool in the desert, you surviving that fall.
WynnExcavation Site D#121.dst: 사막에서 그 늙은 바보를 만난 것도, 그 추락에서 살아남은 것도.
WynnExcavation Site D#121.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#122.src: You finding that notebook, and eventually meeting me.
WynnExcavation Site D#122.dst: 그 수첩을 찾은 것도, 끝내 날 만난 것도.
WynnExcavation Site D#122.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#123.src: Everything that you have done has been planned by the mastermind behind this organisation, me.
WynnExcavation Site D#123.dst: 네가 한 모든 일은 이 조직의 배후에 있는 주모자, 바로 내가 짜 둔 것이다.
WynnExcavation Site D#123.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#124.src: We needed you, an unaware human with some form of pure intent to bring empowered shards here. Anyone else would have ran off with the shards, and turned against us. It's just how it all works. I don't expect you to understand.. Now. Enough talking.
WynnExcavation Site D#124.dst: 아무것도 모르면서 어떤 순수한 의도를 지닌 인간이 충전된 파편을 여기까지 가져와야 했다. 다른 자였다면 파편을 들고 달아나 우리에게 등을 돌렸겠지. 원래 그런 거다. 네가 이해하리라 기대하진 않아.. 자. 말은 이만하면 됐다.
WynnExcavation Site D#124.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#129.src: The crystals combine the power of the stars themselves.. an ultimate power... the power to reign over the entire WORLD!
WynnExcavation Site D#129.dst: 수정은 별 그 자체의 힘을 하나로 모은다.. 궁극의 힘... 온 세계를 지배할 힘이다!
WynnExcavation Site D#129.speaker: Corrupted Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#131.src: I- I- I feel... unstoppable.. this power... will not allow me to lose..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#131.dst: 나- 나- 난... 막을 수 없어.. 이 힘은... 날 지게 두지 않아..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#131.speaker: Shadow Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#133.src: DID YOU REALLY THINK YOU COULD WIN?!?! YOU ARE NOTHING COMPARED TO ME! NOTHING!! I WILL EXTERMINATE ALL LIFE, STARTING WITH YOU!! NOW, PERISH!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#133.dst: 정말 네가 이길 수 있다고 생각했나?!?! 나에 비하면 넌 아무것도 아니다! 아무것도!! 모든 생명을 몰살하겠다, 너부터!! 자, 죽어라!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#133.speaker: Amadel
